mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runtime_profiles ( uuid, external_id, scope, organization_uuid, name, provider_kind, endpoint_url, isolation_mode, config, capability_overrides, secret_envelope, credential_hint, credential_revision, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.Scope}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.ProviderKind}, #{params.EndpointURL}, #{params.IsolationMode}, CAST(#{params.Config} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.CapabilityOverrides} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.SecretEnvelope,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.CredentialHint}, #{params.CredentialRevision}, #{params.Status}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.UpdatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE runtime_profiles SET name = #{params.Name}, endpoint_url = #{params.EndpointURL}, isolation_mode = #{params.IsolationMode}, config = CAST(#{params.Config} AS jsonb), capability_overrides = CAST(#{params.CapabilityOverrides} AS jsonb), secret_envelope = CAST(#{params.SecretEnvelope,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), credential_hint = #{params.CredentialHint}, credential_revision = #{params.CredentialRevision}, status = #{params.Status}, updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE uuid = #{params.UUID} AND version = #{params.Version} RETURNING

mapper.select: SELECT uuid AS organization_uuid, default_runtime_profile_uuid, CAST(COALESCE(to_jsonb(allowed_runtime_profile_uuids), CAST('[]' AS jsonb)) AS text) AS allowed_runtime_profile_uuids_json FROM organizations WHERE uuid = #{organizationUUID}
mapper.update: UPDATE organizations SET default_runtime_profile_uuid = #{params.DefaultRuntimeProfileUUID}, allowed_runtime_profile_uuids = ARRAY( SELECT CAST(value AS uuid) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{params.AllowedRuntimeProfileUUIDsJSON} AS jsonb)) AS value ), updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} RETURNING uuid AS organization_uuid, default_runtime_profile_uuid, CAST(COALESCE(to_jsonb(allowed_runtime_profile_uuids), CAST('[]' AS jsonb)) AS text) AS allowed_runtime_profile_uuids_json
